title: taxonomy: canonical WDA Silvers Prompt ↔ Template Match classification & gap registry
category: core skill · wda silvers prompt ↔ template match classification & gap registry
short_summary: classifies prompts, screenshots, briefs, benchmark slices, and react builds into the locked wda v1.1 prompt ↔ template match taxonomy (3 categories, 15 subcategories, 557 prompts, 257 templates, 77 gap archetypes, and auxiliary dimensions), recommends templates and gaps, audits slice distributions, and extends append-only.
when_to_use: use when labeling a prompt or build with a category, subcategory, surface, or 3d role, querying templates or missing-template gaps, auditing a benchmark dataset slice, or proposing new taxonomy entries.
quick_cmd: python3 taxonomy/scripts/classify_taxonomy.py --query "3d supercar landing page with camera preset toolbar"
summary: Classifies user prompts, UI screenshots, design briefs, benchmark slices, and React deliverables into the canonical two-level WDA Silvers Prompt {-} Template Match taxonomy of 3 locked top-level categories (Landing Page 202, Enterprise 154, Consumer Apps 201 = 557 target prompts across 1,530 battles) and 15 subcategories with immutable kebab-case IDs, coverage metrics, 257 accepted/golden template archetypes, 77 missing-template gap archetypes, and auxiliary dimensions (surface, complexity, 3D slot role, template page type, adaptation flags, loss tags, and WDA V5 16-category mapping). Resolves boundary cases by primary user intent and core loop, recommends matching templates and gap archetypes, audits JSONL slices, and extends the registry append-only without breaking IDs. Use when labeling a prompt or build, querying templates or missing-template gaps, auditing a benchmark dataset, or proposing new taxonomy categories. Don't use for choosing fonts (use google-font-selection), researching benchmarks...
